name: Verify lemniscate axioms using Mathlib complex analysis

source.question: Can any of the axiomatized results be verified using Mathlib's complex analysis?

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Defined lemniscate sets properly using Polynomial.eval + ‖·‖ (no axioms needed for set definitions). Proved basic properties. Assessed axiom eliminability: arc length requires curve integration not in Mathlib. 1 axiom (Danchenko placeholder), 0 sorries, 10 theorems, 177 lines.
insights: Polynomial module moved from Data.Polynomial to Algebra.Polynomial in newer Mathlib
Complex.abs is accessed via ‖·‖ (norm) in current Mathlib API
norm_eq_zero and norm_nonneg are key lemmas for lemniscate proofs
Arc length of ℂ curves is the main Mathlib gap blocking axiom elimination
Danchenko bound potentially provable via Cauchy integral (~500 lines)
mathlibGaps: No arc length for curves in ℂ
No complex curve integration (line integrals over parametric curves)
nextSteps: Define arc length for parametric curves in ℂ (custom infrastructure)
Attempt Danchenko bound via Cauchy integral formula
Connect to Gamma function formula for z^n-1 lemniscate length
